title: Stratum V3.0 Hunt Result
description: Data contract emitted by scripts/swarm_runner.py (agent swarm) at the end of a hunt. Written to data/hunts/latest.json and data/hunts/{timestamp}/hunt_result.json. Integrity rule: every number in top_edges derives from a real scraped price; an empty top_edges array with status 'no_results' is a VALID, honest outcome — fabricated odds are a contract violation.

query.description: The user's original match query, verbatim

agents_executed.description: Agents that were deployed during this hunt

agents_failed.description: Agents that crashed or timed out (report degrades to math-only; confidence penalized)

markets_scanned_count.description: Number of market handles that passed no-vig validation

raw_prices_seen.description: Total individual price rows harvested across all sources

sources.description: Per-source scrape status: ok | empty | blocked | error | timeout | no_fixture | skipped

context_available.description: True when the LLM context agent contributed real notes

mode.description: math_only = context agent unavailable/failed; confidences carry a penalty

top_edges.description: Ranked bets sorted by EV% x Confidence (descending). Empty array when no verified edge exists — NEVER padded with invented prices.

visual_reports_png.description: Repo-relative paths of Matplotlib PNGs generated during THIS run (heatmap / radar / line-movement). Empty if charts could not be built from real data.

data_policy.description: Integrity attestation echoed by the runner

status.description: success >= 1 ranked edge; no_results = honest empty scan; error = swarm failure

market.description: Market display incl. line, e.g. 'Asian Handicap -1.5'

book_odds.description: Best REAL quoted decimal price found across books

fair_odds.description: No-vig fair decimal price (null when handle too thin to de-vig)

ev_percent.description: Expected value % per unit staked vs fair probability

confidence_score.description: 0-100 blend of edge size, book count, movement, liquidity; penalized in math_only mode

reasoning_summary.description: Why this edge exists (signals + context notes), one-liner
